The Chinese characters for Ian

As a transliteration, Ian is usually written 伊恩 (Yī ēn). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

恩

Origin and meaning

Ian is a Scottish name meaning “God is gracious (form of John)”.

About the name Ian

The Scottish form of John, carried by the author Ian Fleming.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Ian as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “God is gracious (form of John)”, is part of the appeal.
